hooks.name: Commit Message Generator

action.prompt:
Run `git diff --cached` and, if nothing is staged, run `git diff`
   instead. Summarize the change and write a single commit message in
   Conventional Commits format (feat:, fix:, chore:, docs:, refactor:,
   test:). Keep the subject line under 72 characters. If the diff touches
   multiple unrelated areas, add a short bullet list in the body. Output
   only the commit message — do not run git commit yourself, I'll review
   and commit manually.

hooks.description:
Draft a commit message for the changes made in the task that was just
   completed.
